description: Live hotel-only search (no flight, no transfer) in any city or resort worldwide for exact dates and party — for travellers who already have transport. Returns up to 10 hotels spread over the price levels (tier: budget / mid_range / upscale / luxury), each with stars, board, room, refundability, area, distance, total and per-night price and its own link, plus a summary of how many hotels exist per star class and from what price. FILTERS: budget (total or per night), stars, board (breakfast…), refundable only, NEAR A PLACE (near_lat + near_lng + radius_km — you supply the coordinates of the landmark, square, station or address the user names), sort. Every price is a PRIVATE room unless include_hostels=true. Use the filters to match what the user asked — never answer "nothing suitable" from an unfiltered list. Give hotel_name to price ONE specific hotel. Prices are the TOTAL for the whole stay and party in EUR, INDICATIVE (the cheapest matching room; other rooms on the hotel page). Booking happens on our site (hotels_search_url / each hotel link). For Turkey/Egypt beach PACKAGES with flight from Tirana use the charter_* tools. LIVE search with a limited daily allowance — never repeat an identical call, but DO call again with filters to refine: the same city, dates and party is answered from our cache and does not use the allowance. If the answer says live_search=false, give the user search_url (the same search pre-filled on our site, prices live there).

board.description: Minimum board that must be INCLUDED in the price (the cheapest room WITH it is priced).

budget_total_max.description: Optional max TOTAL budget in EUR for the whole stay and party.

budget_total_min.description: Optional min TOTAL in EUR for the whole stay (to skip the low end).

children_ages.description: Age of each child on the travel date (REQUIRED when children travel — prices depend on the exact age).

city.description: City / resort, English name (Corfu, Athens, Rome, Belek).

hotel_name.description: Optional: one specific hotel the user named — returns that hotel's real price.

include_hostels.description: true = also hostels, dormitory beds and rooms with a shared bathroom. ONLY when the user asks for a hostel or the absolute cheapest bed — by default every price is a private room with private bathroom.

near_lat.description: Latitude (decimal degrees) of the place the user wants to stay near — a landmark, square, station, venue or address. YOU supply the coordinates (e.g. Piazza del Duomo, Milan = 45.4642, 9.1900). Give near_lat and near_lng together.

price_per_night_max.description: Optional max price PER NIGHT in EUR for the whole party ("up to €120 a night").

radius_km.description: Radius around near_lat/near_lng in km (default 1.5 ≈ a 20-minute walk).

refundable_only.description: true = only cancellable (refundable) rates. The exact free-cancellation deadline is shown on our page before payment.

sort.description: Default "recommended" = a spread over budget / mid-range / upscale / luxury, central real hotels first. "price_low" = literally the cheapest, wherever they are.
